q: Enzymes are protein molecules and biological _____.
e: Enzymes are protein molecules and biological catalysts. Enzymes are biological catalysts that speed reactions without being used up. Proteins are polymers of amino acids with many structural and catalytic jobs. Inhibitors is not catalysts.

q: Enzymes do not require expensive fuel to maintain high _____.
e: Enzymes do not require expensive fuel to maintain high temperature. Enzymes are biological catalysts that speed reactions without being used up. Volume is different: as an animal grows, volume rises faster than surface, so simple skin exchange is not enough.

q: Microbial trypsin is used to treat blood _____.
e: Microbial trypsin is used to treat blood clotting. Blood clotting seals wounds and needs clotting proteins from the liver. Pressure is not clotting.

q: Pancreatic trypsin is used for treatment of _____.
e: Pancreatic trypsin is used for treatment of inflammation. Inflammation is a defensive response with heat, redness, swelling, and pain. Infection is not inflammation.
Proteases are protein -digesting enzymes. Proteins are polymers of amino acids with many structural and catalytic jobs. Enzymes are biological catalysts that speed reactions without being used up.

Lipases are fat -digesting enzymes. Enzymes are biological catalysts that speed reactions without being used up. Protein is different: proteins are polymers of amino acids with many structural and catalytic jobs.

q: Proteases act on red _____ in blood stains.
e: Proteases act on red haemoglobin in blood stains. Haemoglobin in red blood cells binds oxygen for transport. Platelet is not haemoglobin.

q: Fungi produce _____ enzymes for extracting fruit juices.
e: Fungi produce pectinases enzymes for extracting fruit juices. Enzymes are biological catalysts that speed reactions without being used up. Proteases is not pectinases.

q: Pectinases break down pectin between cell walls and separate fruit _____.
e: Pectinases break down pectin between cell walls and separate fruit cells. The cell is the basic living unit; tissues are groups of similar cells. Juice is cleared when pectin is broken, not because cellulose and starch flood out. Seeds is not cells.

q: Break down of polysaccharides causes juice to become _____.
e: Break down of polysaccharides causes juice to become cloudy. An extra chromosome 21 produces Down's syndrome. Dark is not cloudy.

q: Pectinases break polysaccharides to sugar making juice sweeter and _____.
e: Pectinases break polysaccharides to sugar making juice sweeter and clearer. Bitter is not clearer.

q: Biological washing powders remove stains caused by blood, egg, gravy and _____.
e: Biological washing powders remove stains caused by blood, egg, gravy and grease. Biological powders use proteases for protein stains and lipases for fat stains; those jobs are not swapped.

q: Enzymes isolated from cell still retain their ability to _____.
e: Enzymes isolated from cell still retain their ability to function. Function is what a structure does in the living body. Enzymes can still work after they are isolated from the cell; that is why we use them in industry.

q: Many industrial enzymes are obtained from fungi or _____.
e: Many industrial enzymes are obtained from fungi or bacteria. Enzymes are biological catalysts that speed reactions without being used up. Viruses is different: viruses are acellular and only reproduce inside a host cell.

q: Both protein and fat molecules are large but enzymes digest them into small, _____ substances.
e: Both protein and fat molecules are large but enzymes digest them into small, soluble substances. Enzymes are biological catalysts that speed reactions without being used up. Proteins are polymers of amino acids with many structural and catalytic jobs. Solid is not soluble.
